label: Pixel blast
desc: Square pixels blast outward in ragged rings with glowing debris behind the front, on a timer and on every click or tap.
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Pixel snow
desc: Square pixel flakes fall in three depth layers over a dusk gradient and settle into a stair-stepped drift; the pointer pushes them aside.
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Plasma
desc: A classic plasma field of interfering sine waves on a primary-to-signal colour ramp; the pointer adds a rippling source (WebGL, CSS gradient fallback).
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Plasma wave
desc: Eight glowing ribbons of plasma undulate across the width with bright cores and soft halos; the pointer height bends them (WebGL, CSS fallback).
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Prism
desc: A light beam enters a glass prism and leaves as a fan of colour bands from primary to signal; the pointer tilts the incoming beam.
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Prismatic burst
desc: Rays radiate from the centre with a colour fringe that widens with distance, a pulse ring and a shock ring on each click (WebGL, CSS fallback).
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Radar
desc: A radar scope with range rings, a tick bezel and a sweeping beam whose trail lights blips that ping and fade until the next pass.
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Ripple grid
desc: A lattice of lines and nodes heaved by ripples that start by themselves, on clicks and taps, and (smaller) as the pointer moves.
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Scanner
desc: A scan line sweeps down a grid of data cells that flare and burn out behind it; the pointer locks a target bracket onto a cell.
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Shape grid
desc: A grid of circles, squares, triangles and diamonds that swell, turn and warm in colour near the pointer; an idle hand wanders when there is none.
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or campaign section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).
